note: Simple Login restyles the anonymous /user, /user/login, /user/register, /user/password pages with a background image/color and a centered form card. All state is the simplelogin.settings config object (form /admin/config/simplelogin, route simplelogin.admin_settings_form, permission 'administer site configuration'). Keys + shipped defaults: background_active=false, background_image=[], background_color='#00bfff', background_opacity=false, button_background=false, wrapper_width=360, unset_active_css=false, unset_css='', visually_hidden_labels=true. No plugins, no Drush; themed paths extendable via hook_simplelogin_paths_alter(); template page--simplelogin.html.twig. Medium cases write a distinctive value into simplelogin.settings and read it back; hard cases build real config (background_color; button_background+wrapper_width) verified against live config. reset/cleanup restore the shipped defaults explicitly.

evals.prompt: In the simplelogin Drupal module, which config object and admin path control the login-page styling, and what permission is required to reach the settings form?
evals.expected_output: Settings live in simplelogin.settings, edited at /admin/config/simplelogin (route simplelogin.admin_settings_form), gated by the core 'administer site configuration' permission.

evals.prompt: Which pages does the simplelogin module restyle, and for which users does the styling apply?
evals.expected_output: It styles the anonymous user pages /user, /user/login, /user/password and /user/register (only for not-logged-in users). The path list can be extended with hook_simplelogin_paths_alter().

evals.prompt: In simplelogin.settings, which keys decide whether the login page uses a background image versus a solid color, and where is the color stored?
evals.expected_output: background_active (boolean) selects image vs color: when true the page uses the managed file(s) in background_image, when false it uses the hex value in background_color (default #00bfff).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the Simple Login configuration and state the login-page background color that is currently configured.
evals.expected_output: simplelogin.settings background_color is #123456. Read via `drush cget simplelogin.settings background_color`.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the Simple Login configuration and state the configured width (in pixels) of the login form card/wrapper.
evals.expected_output: simplelogin.settings wrapper_width is 480. Read via `drush cget simplelogin.settings wrapper_width`.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure Simple Login so the login pages use the solid background color #ff8800. Apply the change to the live site's configuration.
evals.expected_output: Set simplelogin.settings background_color to '#ff8800', e.g. `drush cset simplelogin.settings background_color '#ff8800' -y` or via the settings form. Verified: background_color === '#ff8800'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure Simple Login to tint the submit buttons and links with the background color (the 'button background' option) and to make the login form card 500 pixels wide. Apply both changes to the live site's configuration.
evals.expected_output: In simplelogin.settings set button_background to true and wrapper_width to 500, e.g. `drush cset simplelogin.settings button_background 1 -y` and `drush cset simplelogin.settings wrapper_width 500 -y`, or via the settings form. Verified: button_background === true AND wrapper_width === 500.
